Notes
PARALLEL RUN FOR SINGLE POINT POSITIONING WITH CODE OBSERVATIONS Shell Variables: (set when running the header file) YEAR : Year of the session to be processed (2 digit) SESSION : Session number (4 characters) CAMPAIGN: Campaign name CAMP_PTH: Campaign path CAMP_DRV: Drive letter for campain (i.e. P) OPT_DIR : Directory for panels PID : Process identification number (3 digits) SUB_PID : Subprocess id (3 digits) PRT_FILE: Protocol file name including path SCRIPT : Name of script TASKID : Task id of script, usually 00 PRIORITY: Priority of the script CPU : CPU the script is running on DAYYEAR : Julian day of the year DAY : Day of the Month MONTH : Month, 1=JAN, 12=DEC GPSWEEK : GPS week DAYWEEK : Day of the week, 0=SUN, 6=SAT V_X : X Variable in DAT151__.PAN V_O : O Variable in DAT151__.PAN V_Z : Z Variable in DAT151__.PAN V_PLUS : Plus variable in DAT151__.PAN V_MINUS : Minus variable in DAT151__.PAN V_x : User variable PARAMx : Script specific parameter, x is 1 thru 9 U : Directory path to U: use the new menu system

Notes
YEAR : Year of the session to be processed (2 digit) SESSION : Session number (4 characters) CAMPAIGN: Campaign name CAMP_PTH: Campaign path CAMP_DRV: Drive letter for campain (i.e. P) OPT_DIR : Directory for panels PID : Process identification number (3 digits) SUB_PID : Subprocess id (3 digits) PRT_FILE: Protocol file name including path SCRIPT : Name of script TASKID : Task id of script, usually 00 PRIORITY: Priority of the script CPU : CPU the script is running on DAYYEAR : Julian day of the year DAY : Day of the Month MONTH : Month, 1=JAN, 12=DEC GPSWEEK : GPS week DAYWEEK : Day of the week, 0=SUN, 6=SAT V_X : X Variable in DAT151__.PAN V_O : O Variable in DAT151__.PAN V_Z : Z Variable in DAT151__.PAN V_PLUS : Plus variable in DAT151__.PAN V_MINUS : Minus variable in DAT151__.PAN V_x : User variable PARAMx : Script specific parameter, x is 1 thru 9 U : Directory path to U: use the new menu system

  • Package: FIX_CHK
  • Programs: HELMR1
  • INP files: 3
  • Deletes: 2
  • Used in PCFs: 3

Source header

Name
FIX_CHK
Purpose
Execute HELMR1 Remark : This script permits automatic verification of a given set of fiducial stations. In case of discrepancies, a modified FIX file can be output by HELMR1 and thus used to directly repeat the last ADDNEQ2 run, finally considering a reduced set of fiducial stations accepted for consistent datum definition.
Parameters
PARAM2 - goto PID for new datum definition (optionally) PARAM3 - STOP option for CRD (cross-)checking (optionally)
Author
M. Meindl, S. Schaer
Created
19-Oct-2003
Changes
07-Feb-2006/ss: Check whether PARAM2 defined 02-Sep-2010/ss/mm: Deactivated outlier rejection for second HELMR1 run 26-Sep-2012/ss: Further developed 27-Sep-2012/ss: STOP option implemented (activated with PARAM3) 28-Sep-2012/ss: Print LST filename in case of a stop 17-Apr-2013/hb: Exception for doy 13102 F1-F1C added 18-Apr-2013/cb: Exception for doy 13103 F3-F3C added 29-May-2013/cb: Exceptions for doy 13144 F3S and 13145 F1S added 30-May-2013/cb: Exceptions for doy 13146 F1S and 13145 F3S added 31-May-2013/cb: Exceptions for doy 13147 F1S and 13146 F3S added 01-Jun-2013/cb: Exceptions for doy 13148 F1S and 13147 F3S added 02-Jun-2013/cb: Exceptions for doy 13149 F1S and 13148 F3S added 03-Jun-2013/hb: Exceptions for doy 13150 F1S and 13149 F3S added 03-Jun-2013/ss: Most recent exceptions removed 04-Jun-2014/ss: Considered ULTyyddd.FLG 10-Sep-2014/ss: Increased tolerances in case of RAP 16-Dec-2014/ss/av: Updated for new HELMR1 (with ADDSTA/MAXREJ) 16-SEP-2015/rd: Relax HELMR1 check if singular elements are detected 19-Sep-2019/av: Use regex for IGSRAPID and IGSULTRA check 23-Feb-2024 SS: Corrective action automatically done if indicated

Source header

Changes
27-Aug-2001 rd: switch to the new menu system 14-Mar-2002 mm: "Code-DD"-GPSEST, RESRMS and SATMRK added 18-Mar-2002 mm: Enable iterations (code screening and Wuebb only in first iteration) 30-Mar-2002 ss: Create baseline-specific W1 (P1-C1) DCB NQ0 02-Sep-2002 ss: Check whether CSO file available 14-Sep-2002 ss: ADDNEQ2 run to retrieve DCB values just after WL AR 17-Sep-2002 ss: Make use of improved GPSEST version 18-Sep-2002 ss: Number of NPUTKEY reduced 28-Jul-2003 rd: Adapt to the new BPE ("\$CD4"->"\$(CD4)", no links anymore) 29-Jul-2003 rd: Replace "{]}" by "]" in path names 29-Jul-2003 rd: Quotes for \$(CD4) 21-Jan-2004 ss: Set PRE04 when needed 14-Apr-2005 mm: TITLE set correctly (w/o STRING) 02-Mar-2011 ss: CD4 replaced by FFFF 20.May.2016 ss/av: Modified due ro OSB implementation GPSAMB_P
Notes
PARALLEL RUN FOR AMBIGUITY FIXING (BASELINE BY BASELINE) USING MELWUB Shell Variables: (set when running the header file) YEAR : Year of the session to be processed (2 digit) SESSION : Session number (4 characters) CAMPAIGN: Campaign name CAMP_PTH: Campaign path CAMP_DRV: Drive letter for campain (i.e. P) OPT_DIR : Directory for panels PID : Process identification number (3 digits) SUB_PID : Subprocess id (3 digits) PRT_FILE: Protocol file name including path SCRIPT : Name of script TASKID : Task id of script, usually 00 PRIORITY: Priority of the script CPU : CPU the script is running on DAYYEAR : Julian day of the year DAY : Day of the Month MONTH : Month, 1=JAN, 12=DEC GPSWEEK : GPS week DAYWEEK : Day of the week, 0=SUN, 6=SAT V_X : X Variable in DAT151__.PAN V_O : O Variable in DAT151__.PAN V_Z : Z Variable in DAT151__.PAN V_PLUS : Plus variable in DAT151__.PAN V_MINUS : Minus variable in DAT151__.PAN V_x : User variable PARAMx : Script specific parameter, x is 1 thru 9 U : Directory path to U: Use the new menu

Source header

Name
RES_SUM
Purpose
Check zero- or double-difference data screening results and creates a summary on the residual screening: 1. RESRMS to create F(irst) residual screening summary 2. RESRMS to create L(ast) residual screening summary 3. RESCHK to create residual screening statistics Binary data files of misbehaving stations are subsequently removed if indicated After deleting stations the BPE processing is continued with SNGDIF in case of double-difference processing.
Parameters
PARAM1 - "NEXTJOB"-indicator (if necessary) PARAM2 - goto PID in case of misbehaving stations

Created
